name: _elementtree_Element_findall_impl

name: _elementtree_Element_get_impl

name: _elementtree_Element_keys_impl

name: element_ass_subscr

name: element_attrib_getter
reason: AttribInvariant only says the slot stays a dict, frozendict or NULL; a getter that returns a fresh empty dict without storing it satisfies it.

name: element_attrib_setter
reason: AttribInvariant only constrains successful stores, so a setter that refuses every value, or accepts it without storing, satisfies it; the dict/frozendict acceptance is not pinned.
